  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JANUARY-2024  
  Scientific Thinking and Creativity [PHY-4322]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           In the context of deductivism, what is the fundamental idea behind testing scientific  
  theories, and how does it differ from the approach of inductivism? Use appropriate  
  (5)  
  examples to support your reasoning.  
  A)  
  B)      Explain why "Seeing is believing" is not a good enough reason for having scientific  
  knowledge.                                                                                 (3)  
  
  C)      Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of acquiring knowledge through empirical  
  knowledge.                                                                                 (2)  
  
  2)           Explain the phase model of scientific progress and discuss each phase with suitable  
  examples.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Describe the concept of fallibilism in the context of science and explain how it  
  challenges the notion of absolute certainty in scientific knowledge.                       (3)  
  
  C)      What criteria differentiate between scientific and pseudo-scientific theories?             (2)  
  3)           Is scientific knowledge more systematic than other forms of knowledge? Justify your  
  answers using real-life examples.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Using appropriate examples, explain how explanations are more systematic in scientific  
  knowledge than other forms of knowledge.                                               (3)  
  
  C)      What is critical discourse? Discuss its importance in knowledge generation.                (2)  
  4)           Define creativity and classify the different types of creativity using appropriate  
  examples.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      What is computational creativity, its goals, and its different approaches?                 (3)

  5)            Evaluate the ethical considerations of emerging technologies like gene editing or AI-  
  based decision-making. We must address these concerns before the widespread  
  (5)

  A)  
  B)       Analyze how popular scientific fiction and media influence the public's perception of  
  emerging technologies.                                                                   (3)  
  
  C)       Describe the categorical imperative theory of ethics.                                    (2)
